source_instruction: i am looking for tulua apple cider vinegar lemon ginger flavored fruit juice that is certified organic.
query:
Ugh, I swear the community garden plot I signed up for back in spring is out to test every last bit of my patience this week. I showed up yesterday to water my tomato plants and found that a family of very bold, very chonky squirrels had chewed through half the mesh covering I put up to keep critters out, and they’d nibbled right through three of my almost-ripe heirloom tomatoes too. On the walk over to the garden this morning I even stopped to say hi to the fluffy orange feral cat that hangs out by the entrance, and the little guy straight up stole the blueberry muffin I’d stashed in my tote bag for my post-watering snack before I could even blink. I was still laughing about that silly little heist when I cut through the grocery store on my way home, figuring I’d knock a few things off my list instead of making a separate trip later.
Hey there, I’m browsing the beverages section right now trying to grab some nice certified organic vinegar, y’know? I want one that comes with a free reusable silicone pour spout bundled right with the bottle, and I’m only looking to spend a reasonable amount on it since I don’t wanna blow my grocery budget this week. Wait, actually, hold on, I know I had a specific kind I loved last time but I’m totally blanking on the exact flavor and brand I need to pick up. Can you help me track down the right option that fits what I’m looking for?

extras.text: comes with a free reusable silicone pour spout bundled right with the bottle
